title: A real two-store close: people paid from the till, deposit copied even when it looks wrong
why: Store credit/cash, Gas, a name+amount (Ahsan 21, Umar 220-) are till payouts not hours, and Total deposit is saved as written so a typo like 6611 is flagged. One shared group can cover both stores; each close still lands on its own store id.
